(Published by Authority) PART III — LANDS
Land Acquisition Notices

No. 1896/17 – TUESDAY, JANUARY 06, 2015
EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Notice under Section 7

IT is hereby give notice under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964 that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude* which is required for a public purpose.
Description of the Land or Servitude to be acquired:

The land called Jangarakotuwawatta or Thalgaha-mulawatta of about 0.1356 Hectare in extent. Depicted in the Surveyor General’s Preliminary Plan No. M 1581 situated in the Village of Dorakumbura of E 340 Dora-kumbura Grama Niladhari Division, Minor Division of Asgiri Udasiyapattuwa at Divisional Secretary’s Division of Yatawatta of Matale District of Central Province.

Lot No. 01 Name of the Land: —; Description: —; Claimant: Wijerathna Bandara Dorakumbura, No. 145/2 Lady Mc, Collum and Ekanayaka Mudiyanselage Chithra Padmini Kumari Dorakumbura, No. 11, College Place, Matale; Extent: 0.1356 Hectare.

North: Jangarakotuwawatta or Thalgahamulawatta claiming by A. G. Ananda and Jangarakotuwawatta or Thalgahamulawatta claiming by Y. G. Loku Banda; East: Matale Attipola (Pradeshiya Sabha) Road; South: Janga-rakotuwawatta or Thalgahamulawatta claiming by E. M. E. G. Senaviratna; West: Jangarakotuwawatta or Thal-gahamulawatta claiming by A. G. Ananda.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands* on which a servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at Yatawatta Divisional Secretariat, on the 26th day of January, 2015 at 10.00 o’ clock and are hereby requested to notify me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 12th day of January, 2015 the nature of their interests in the land the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/ servitude*, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
A. M. J. K. N. ADIKARI, Divisional Secretary, Yatawatta.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Yatawatta, 23rd December, 2014. 01 - 600
